title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_en: Pointing at the mulberry to scold the locust tree
summary_zh: 本页展示了成语“指桑骂槐”的标题，配有一名骑马的古代武将插图，暗示该成语的典故背景。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 明太祖朱元璋小的时候，家里很穷。他小小年纪就给别人家放牛，长大后还做过和尚。朱元璋知道穷人的生活苦，所以起兵后对士兵们的要求非常严格，绝不允许他们欺负老百姓。
page_text_en: When Emperor Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang was young, his family was very poor. He started herding cattle for others at a young age and later became a monk. Zhu Yuanzhang knew how hard poor people's lives were, so after raising an army, he had very strict rules for his soldiers and absolutely forbade them from bullying the common people.
summary_zh: 本页通过文字介绍了明太祖朱元璋幼年贫苦的经历，以及他因深知百姓疾苦而对士兵严格要求、禁止欺压百姓的背景，为后续成语故事做铺垫。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 可是，许多后来投降加入的士兵，却不守军纪，屡次犯错。有的士兵冲进村子，烧杀抢掠。"这伙贼兵，抢粮又抢钱，还要放火烧我的房子，真是坏透了呀！"
page_text_en: However, many soldiers who later defected and joined the army did not follow military discipline and repeatedly committed wrongdoings. Some soldiers rushed into villages, burning, killing, and looting. "These bandits, stealing grain and money, and even setting fire to my house—truly despicable!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了部分投降士兵不守军纪、烧杀抢掠的场景，一位村民被士兵殴打，另一些士兵则抢夺粮食、钱财和家畜，村民愤怒地控诉其暴行。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh:
有的士兵闯进街上的店铺，白拿货物。"这绸缎真软真滑，拿回去给我娘子做新衣服正好！"我们店小利薄，求几位给个本钱呀！"店主拉扯着士兵哀求道。
"哼，你这店家怎么这么小气，我们起义军拿你几匹绸缎，还想要钱？"
page_text_en:
Some soldiers burst into shops on the street and took goods without paying. "This silk is so soft and smooth, perfect for making new clothes for my wife!" "Our shop has small profits, please give us some capital!" the shopkeeper pleaded, pulling at the soldiers.
"Hmph, how stingy you are! We're revolutionary troops taking a few bolts of silk from you—do you really expect money?"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了部分士兵强抢店铺绸缎的场景，店主哀求未果，士兵以起义军身份为由拒绝支付，展现了军纪败坏、欺压百姓的暴行。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 有的士兵闯进百姓的家里，抓人到军中干活儿。‘我们军中就缺个马夫，你去给我们喂马吧！’百姓对起义军恨得牙痒痒，都希望他们早点落败。
page_text_en: Some soldiers broke into civilians' homes and forced people to work for the army. 'We're short on a groom in our army. Go feed our horses for us!' The civilians hated the rebel army deeply and wished for their early defeat.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了部分士兵强行闯入百姓家中，抓人充当马夫的场景，百姓对此极为憎恨，希望起义军早日失败。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 朱元璋听说士兵们到处烧杀抢掠，气得大叫道："把这些人都给我抓起来，通通斩了！"但是，杀了这几个小兵又有什么用呢？那些胆大心黑的降兵一点都不害怕。朱元璋想："看来，这种杀鸡儆猴的方法吓不住他们，得找一个违反军纪的大将来处罚，才能震慑住他们，让他们不敢再犯！"
page_text_en: Zhu Yuanzhang heard that the soldiers were burning, killing, and looting everywhere, and he shouted angrily: "Bring all of them to me and execute them all!" But what good would it do to kill just a few soldiers? The bold and heartless defectors weren't afraid at all. Zhu Yuanzhang thought: "It seems that this method of killing a chicken to scare the monkeys won't frighten them. I need to find a high-ranking general who broke military discipline to punish, so as to intimidate them and make them dare not commit such acts again!"
summary_zh: 朱元璋得知士兵烧杀抢掠后大怒，想处决所有犯事士兵，但意识到仅杀小兵无法震慑胆大妄为的降兵，于是决定寻找一个违反军纪的大将进行处罚，以达到杀鸡儆猴、震慑全军的目的。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 军中的大将都知道，朱元璋军纪严苛，谁又敢明知故犯呢？一时半会儿，朱元璋想抓出一个人来处罚，还真不容易。正在这时，大将军徐达来见朱元璋。朱元璋起义时，徐达是第一个来投奔他的人。徐达领兵出征，战无不胜，攻无不克，士兵们都很佩服他。
page_text_en: All the generals in the army knew that Zhu Yuanzhang had strict military discipline. Who would dare to deliberately break the rules? For a while, it was really difficult for Zhu Yuanzhang to find someone to punish. Just then, General Xu Da came to see Zhu Yuanzhang. When Zhu Yuanzhang started his rebellion, Xu Da was the first to join him. Xu Da led troops into battle, winning every fight and conquering every fortress. The soldiers all admired him greatly.
summary_zh: 本页描述了朱元璋因军纪严明而难以找到违纪士兵处罚，此时大将军徐达前来拜见。徐达是朱元璋起义时最早投奔的将领，战功赫赫，深受士兵敬佩。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 徐达对朱元璋说："大元帅，明天我就要领兵攻打镇江了。可是，最近经常有士兵抢夺百姓的财物，咱们得先想个办法，整顿整顿军纪才行呀！" 朱元璋嘿嘿一笑："我也正有此意。我有个法子，不过需要你配合我。"
page_text_en: Xu Da said to Zhu Yuanzhang: "Commander-in-chief, tomorrow I will lead the troops to attack Zhenjiang. But recently, soldiers have often been stealing from the people. We must think of a way to rectify the military discipline!" Zhu Yuanzhang chuckled: "I have the same idea. I have a plan, but I need your cooperation."
summary_zh: 徐达向朱元璋汇报即将攻打镇江，同时反映士兵抢夺百姓财物、军纪败坏的问题。朱元璋表示已有对策，但需要徐达配合。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 第二天一大早，校场上战旗飘扬。步兵们排成方阵，长枪林立，战刀雪亮。骑兵们跨在战马上，穿着鱼鳞甲，身后背着角弓，挂着箭囊，手中握着腰刀。大军整装待发，只等一声令下，就要攻打镇江。
page_text_en: The next morning, the training ground was filled with fluttering battle flags. Infantry soldiers formed square formations, with long spears standing tall and swords gleaming. Cavalrymen rode their warhorses, clad in fish-scale armor, with horn bows slung behind them, quivers hanging, and waist swords in hand. The army was fully prepared, waiting only for the command to attack Zhenjiang.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了军队整装待发的场景，步兵列阵、骑兵备马，战旗飘扬，大军准备攻打镇江。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 可奇怪的是，士兵们站在校场上，等到日上三竿，领兵的徐达大将军还没来。士兵们不由得嘀咕起来。"出什么事了？""徐将军病了？""作战计划变了？"
page_text_en: Strange as it may seem, the soldiers stood on the drill ground, waiting until the sun was high in the sky, but their commanding general, Xu Da, had not yet arrived. The soldiers couldn't help but mutter among themselves. "What's going on?" "Is General Xu sick?" "Has the battle plan changed?"
summary_zh: 士兵们在校场上等待领兵的徐达大将军，但其迟迟未到，士兵们开始议论纷纷，猜测原因。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh:
“听说徐将军抢了人家祖传的宝玉呢！”
“徐将军跟着大元帅东征西讨，立下多少汗马功劳啊，大元帅不会重罚吧？”
一名消息灵通的士兵悄悄地说：
“你们还不知道吧，徐将军被抓起来了！”一石激起千层浪，士兵们立刻议论起来：“为什么呀？”
page_text_en:
"I heard General Xu stole someone's family heirloom jade!"
"General Xu has followed the Grand Commander east and west, achieving so many great military merits. Won't the Grand Commander punish him severely?"
A well-informed soldier whispered: 
"You still don't know? General Xu has been arrested!" A single stone stirred up a thousand waves. The soldiers immediately began discussing: "Why?"
summary_zh: 士兵们听说大将军徐达因抢夺百姓宝玉被逮捕，纷纷议论，对这一消息感到震惊和不解。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 忽然，士兵们你碰碰我，我碰碰你，全都闭上了嘴。原来是大元帅来了，校场上立刻鸦雀无声。朱元璋铁青着脸，在一众将领、卫兵的簇拥下走了过来。在他们身后，徐达将军被反绑着双手，由两名士兵押着。
page_text_en: Suddenly, the soldiers bumped into each other, then all fell silent. The Grand Commander had arrived, and the training ground instantly fell silent as if a sparrow had not chirped. Zhu Yuanzhang, his face ashen with anger, walked forward, surrounded by a group of generals and guards. Behind them, General Xu Da was being led in, his hands bound behind his back by two soldiers.
summary_zh: 朱元璋铁青着脸来到校场，身后押着被反绑双手的徐达将军，士兵们震惊沉默，场面肃穆紧张。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh:
执法官用洪亮的声音宣布："徐达身为大将军，不知约束自己，也管不好手下的将士，多次欺压百姓，坏了我起义军的名声。为严明军纪，大元帅命令，将徐达斩首示众！"
"啊？"将士们都惊呆了，吓得脸色惨白。几条抢过东西的士兵，更是觉得执法官的话，声声砸在自己的身上，吓得差点晕倒。
page_text_en:
The judge announced in a loud voice: "Xu Da, as a general, fails to restrain himself and cannot manage his subordinates. He has repeatedly oppressed the people, damaging the reputation of our rebel army. To uphold military discipline, the Commander-in-Chief orders that Xu Da be executed and displayed publicly!"
"Ah?" The soldiers were stunned, their faces turning pale with fear. Several soldiers who had stolen things felt the judge's words hitting them like blows, trembling so much they nearly fainted.
summary_zh: 执法官宣布大将军徐达因欺压百姓、军纪败坏被判处斩首示众，士兵们震惊不已，尤其是曾抢夺百姓财物的士兵，感到恐惧和自责。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh:
过了一会儿，众将士回过神来，一齐跪下哀求说："大元帅，徐将军作战英勇，屡立大功。而且我们马上就要攻打镇江了，正是用将的时候，大元帅就饶了他吧！"
"军中发生欺压百姓的事，不只是徐将军的错，我们也错了。求大元帅饶他一次吧！"
page_text_en:
After a while, the soldiers regained their composure and knelt together, pleading: "Great Commander, General Xu is brave in battle and has achieved great merits. Moreover, we are about to attack Zhenjiang. Now is exactly the time we need him. Please spare him, Great Commander!"
"The incident of bullying civilians in the army is not only General Xu's fault; we are also wrong. Please spare him this once, Great Commander!"
summary_zh: 士兵们得知徐达被处决后，纷纷跪下向朱元璋求情，恳请饶恕徐达，认为他功勋卓著且正值用兵之际，同时承认自己也有过错。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 朱元璋站在那里，听着大家求情，却一言不发。过了好半天，他才指着徐达喝道："看在众将士的面子上，这次就饶了你。以后军中再有人欺压百姓，定斩不饶！"说罢，朱元璋拂袖而去。大家连忙上前，给徐达松了绑。徐达当场宣布："打下镇江后，一不许烧房，二不许强抢，三不许欺凌百姓。违者斩首示众！"
page_text_en: Zhu Yuanzhang stood there, listening to everyone's pleas, but said nothing. After a long while, he pointed at Xu Da and shouted, "For the sake of the soldiers, I'll spare you this time. But if anyone in the army oppresses the people again, they will be executed without mercy!" Then Zhu Yuanzhang turned and left. Everyone rushed forward to untie Xu Da. Xu Da immediately announced, "After we capture Zhenjiang, one: no burning houses, two: no looting, three: no bullying the people. Violators will be executed and displayed for all to see!"
summary_zh: 朱元璋在士兵求情后决定饶恕徐达，并当场宣布军纪，徐达随即宣布攻打镇江后的三项禁令，以儆效尤。

title_en: Naming the Plum to Scold the Peach
page_text_ocr_zh: 随后，徐达率军攻下了镇江。进城后，大军悄无声息，没有一名士兵敢闯进百姓家抢东西。当地的百姓竟然不知道，起义军已经进城了！朱元璋高兴地对徐达说："大将军，在校场上真是委屈你了！"原来，在校场上，朱元璋要斩徐达的话，其实是说给那些违反军纪的士兵听的。这一招"指桑骂槐"的计策，成功震慑了全军！
page_text_en: Then, Xu Da led his army to capture Zhenjiang. After entering the city, the troops moved silently, and not a single soldier dared to enter a civilian's home to steal anything. The local people didn't even realize that the rebel army had already entered the city! Zhu Yuanzhang happily said to Xu Da: "General, you were truly wronged on the training ground!" In fact, Zhu Yuanzhang's words about executing Xu Da on the training ground were meant for those soldiers who had broken military discipline. This clever tactic of "pointing at the mulberry to scold the locust tree" successfully intimidated the entire army!
summary_zh: 徐达率军攻下镇江后，军队纪律严明，百姓不知城已被占。朱元璋向徐达表示歉意，并解释此前处决他的计策实为‘指桑骂槐’，用以震慑全军，最终成功整顿军纪。
